<![CDATA[import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { IBM_Plex_Mono, Lora, Public_Sans } from "next/font/google";
import "./serein/serein.css";

const display = Lora({
  weight: ["400", "500"],
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-lora",
});
const body = Public_Sans({
  weight: ["400", "500", "600"],
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-public-sans",
});
const mono = IBM_Plex_Mono({
  weight: ["400", "500", "600"],
  subsets: ["latin"],
  variable: "--font-ibm-plex-mono",
});

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: "SEREIN Bureau — Small weather, closely observed",
  description: "A fold-out weather almanac from SEREIN Bureau.",
};

export default function SereinLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning className={`${display.variable} ${body.variable} ${mono.variable}`}>
      <body className="sr-body">
        <script dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: "document.documentElement.classList.add('js');" }} />
        {children}
        <noscript>
          <style>{`[data-reveal]{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;clip-path:none!important}`}</style>
        </noscript>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(serein)/serein/assets.tsx">
<![CDATA[import { ASSETS } from "./assets.generated";

const BASE = "/templates/serein";

export function assetSrc(key: string, width: 800 | 1600, format: "webp" | "avif" = "webp"): string | null {
  return key in ASSETS ? `${BASE}/${key}-${width}.${format}` : null;
}

export function Picture({ assetKey, alt, className }: { assetKey: string; alt: string; className?: string }) {
  const source = assetSrc(assetKey, 800);
  if (!source) {
    return (
      <div className={`sr-picture-placeholder ${className ?? ""}`} role="img" aria-label={alt} data-asset={assetKey}>
        <span>{assetKey}</span>
      </div>
    );
  }
  const { w, h } = ASSETS[assetKey];
  return <img src={source} width={w} height={h} alt={alt} className={className} loading="eager" decoding="async" fetchPriority="high" />;
}
]]>
    </file>

::selection { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 36%, transparent); color: var(--color-ink); }

@media (max-width: 60rem) { :root { --gutter: 28px; --gap-columns: 24px; } }
@media (max-width: 40rem) { :root { --gutter: 18px; --gap-columns: 16px; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

<![CDATA[import { ImageResponse } from "next/og";

export const size = { width: 1200, height: 630 };
export const contentType = "image/png";
export const alt = "SEREIN Bureau — Small weather, closely observed.";

const PAPER = "#F6F0E5";
const INK = "#24343A";
const SEAFOAM = "#A8D6CC";

export default function OpenGraphImage() {
  return new ImageResponse(
    (
      <div
        style={{
          width: "100%",
          height: "100%",
          display: "flex",
          flexDirection: "column",
          justifyContent: "space-between",
          padding: "64px",
          backgroundColor: PAPER,
          color: INK,
          fontFamily: "serif",
        }}
      >
        <div style={{ display: "flex", alignItems: "center", gap: 18, fontSize: 26 }}>
          <span style={{ width: 48, height: 48, border: `2px solid ${INK}`, borderRadius: 999, display: "flex" }} />
          <span>Serein Bureau / SR-07</span>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 18 }}>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", fontSize: 88, lineHeight: 0.98, maxWidth: 950 }}>A little weather, held close.</div>
          <div style={{ display: "flex", fontSize: 26, color: INK }}>Small weather, closely observed.</div>
        </div>
        <div style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", fontSize: 22 }}>
          <span>Fold-out forecast strip</span>
          <span style={{ color: SEAFOAM }}>1008 hPa / 7 panels</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    ),
    { ...size },
  );
}

<![CDATA[import { Logo } from "./brand/Logo";
import { ScrollEffects } from "./motion/ScrollEffects";
import { LandingSections } from "./sections/LandingSections";
import { PANELS } from "./sections/Panels";

export default function SereinPage() {
  return (
    <>
      <ScrollEffects />
      <a className="sr-skip" href="#outlook">Skip to the forecast</a>
      <header className="sr-header">
        <Logo />
        <nav className="sr-nav" aria-label="Forecast panels">
          {PANELS.slice(1, 6).map((panel) => <a key={panel.id} href={`#${panel.id}`}>{panel.label}</a>)}
        </nav>
        <a className="sr-header__cta" href="#subscribe">Join the dispatch</a>
      </header>
      <main>
        <section id="outlook" className="sr-intro" aria-labelledby="serein-title">
          <div className="sr-intro__copy">
            <div className="sr-intro__meta"><span>Open issue 07</span><span>51.52° N / 0.09° W</span><span>New moon / 2026</span></div>
            <h1 id="serein-title">Small weather,<br /><span>closely observed.</span></h1>
            <p>Reports from the places between the forecast and the feeling.</p>
            <div className="sr-intro__actions"><a className="sr-button" href="#forecast">Read the forecast</a><a className="sr-text-link" href="#bureau">The bureau note</a></div>
          </div>
          <div className="sr-intro__orb" aria-hidden="true">
            <div className="sr-intro__orb-grid" />
            <div className="sr-intro__orb-reading"><span>Current reading</span><strong>1016</strong><small>hPa / SW 12 kt</small></div>
            <span /><span /><span />
          </div>
        </section>
        <LandingSections />
      </main>
      <footer className="sr-footer">
        <Logo compact />
        <p>Small weather, closely observed.<br /><span>© 2026 SEREIN Bureau / Filed in the open air.</span></p>
        <div className="sr-footer__links"><a href="#bureau">The bureau</a><a href="#forecast">The forecast</a><a href="#dispatch">Dispatch</a></div>
        <a className="sr-footer__top" href="#outlook">Back to the cover</a>
      </footer>
    </>
  );
}

<![CDATA[/* Hallmark · shape: split field report · genre: atmospheric · theme: brand · redesign: full
 * paper: #F6F0E5 · accent: #A8D6CC · display: Lora · body: Public Sans · hero: Stage · nav: edge-aligned · footer: statement · signature: live pressure instrument
 * axes: light/roman-serif/chromatic-teal · posture: committed · contrast: pass · fold: pass · v2.0.0 */
/* Hallmark · pre-emit critique: P_ preserved anchors and local form · H_ pressure instrument owns the fold · E_ no external imagery · S_ varied grid, strip, index and band · R_ content visible without motion · V_ display copy stays roman and direct */
@import url("./tokens.css");
@import url("./base.css");

html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

.sr-body {
  --sr-gutter: var(--gutter);
  min-width: 320px;
  background-color: var(--sr-paper);
  background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 5%, transparent) 0 1px, transparent 1px 9px);
  color: var(--sr-ink);
}

.sr-body::selection { background: var(--sr-lavender); color: var(--sr-ink); }
.sr-body :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--sr-lavender-deep); outline-offset: 3px; }

.sr-vh {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  overflow: clip;
  clip-path: inset(50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.sr-skip {
  position: fixed;
  z-index: var(--z-toast);
  top: var(--space-md);
  left: var(--space-md);
  padding: var(--space-xs) var(--space-md);
  background: var(--sr-ink);
  color: var(--sr-paper);
  text-decoration: none;
  transform: translateY(-180%);
  transition: transform var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out);
}
.sr-skip:focus-visible { transform: none; }

/* Chrome */
.sr-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: var(--z-sticky);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--gap-columns);
  width: min(var(--container), 100%);
  min-height: 76px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: var(--space-sm) var(--sr-gutter);
  border-bottom: var(--rule-hair) solid var(--sr-rule-soft);
  background: var(--sr-paper);
  transition: background-color var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out), border-color var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out);
}
.sr-header::after { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -2px; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--sr-seafoam); content: ""; transform: scaleX(var(--sr-scroll-progress, 0)); transform-origin: left; pointer-events: none; }
.sr-body[data-scrolled="true"] .sr-header { border-bottom-color: var(--sr-rule); background: var(--sr-paper-2); }
.sr-logo {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  color: var(--sr-ink);
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.sr-logo__mark { width: 42px; height: 42px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.sr-logo__mark { transition: transform var(--dur-long) var(--ease-in-out); }
.sr-logo:hover .sr-logo__mark,
.sr-logo:focus-visible .sr-logo__mark { transform: rotate(-8deg); }
.sr-logo__words { display: grid; gap: var(--space-3xs); line-height: 1; }
.sr-logo__words > span { font-family: var(--sr-display); font-size: 1.22rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.sr-logo__words small { color: var(--sr-ink-2); font: 500 var(--text-xs)/1.2 var(--sr-body); }
.sr-nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: clamp(var(--space-md), 2.5vw, var(--space-xl));
  min-width: 0;
}
.sr-nav a,
.sr-footer__links a,
.sr-footer__top {
  position: relative;
  color: inherit;
  font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-body);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.sr-nav a { padding: var(--space-xs) 0; white-space: nowrap; }
.sr-nav a::after,
.sr-footer__links a::after {
  position: absolute;
  right: 100%;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 1px;
  background: currentColor;
  content: "";
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out);
}
.sr-nav a:hover::after,
.sr-nav a:focus-visible::after,
.sr-nav a[aria-current="true"]::after,
.sr-footer__links a:hover::after,
.sr-footer__links a:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
.sr-header__cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 0 var(--space-lg);
  border: 1px solid var(--sr-ink);
  background: var(--sr-ink);
  color: var(--sr-paper);
  font: 600 var(--text-sm)/1 var(--sr-body);
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background-color var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out), color var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-micro) var(--ease-out);
}
.sr-header__cta:hover { background: var(--sr-seafoam); color: var(--sr-ink); }
.sr-header__cta:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

/* Hero */
.sr-intro {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 6fr) minmax(0, 5fr);
  align-items: center;
  gap: clamp(var(--space-2xl), 7vw, var(--space-4xl));
  width: min(var(--container), 100%);
  min-height: calc(100svh - 76px);
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: clamp(var(--space-3xl), 10vh, 132px) var(--sr-gutter) clamp(var(--space-2xl), 8vh, 112px);
  border-bottom: var(--rule-hair) solid var(--sr-rule);
  overflow: clip;
}
.sr-intro__copy { position: relative; z-index: 2; min-width: 0; }
.sr-intro__meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-xs) var(--space-lg);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-xl);
  color: var(--sr-ink-2);
  font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.3 var(--sr-body);
}
.sr-intro h1 {
  max-width: 11ch;
  font: 500 clamp(4.25rem, 7vw, 7.6rem)/0.84 var(--sr-display);
  letter-spacing: -0.065em;
}
.sr-intro h1 span { display: block; color: inherit; }
.sr-intro__copy > p {
  max-width: 31ch;
  margin-top: var(--space-xl);
  color: var(--sr-ink-2);
  font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 1.2vw, 1.3rem);
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.sr-intro__actions {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 3;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-lg) var(--space-xl);
  margin-top: var(--space-xl);
}

.sr-button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 50px;
  padding: 0 var(--space-lg);
  border: 1px solid var(--sr-ink);
  border-radius: var(--radius-input);
  background: var(--sr-ink);
  color: var(--sr-paper);
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 600 var(--text-sm)/1 var(--sr-body);
  text-decoration: none;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: background-color var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out), color var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-micro) var(--ease-out);
}
.sr-button:hover { background: var(--sr-seafoam); color: var(--sr-ink); }
.sr-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
.sr-button:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }
.sr-button[aria-busy="true"] { cursor: progress; }
.sr-button[aria-busy="true"]::after { width: 13px; height: 13px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-right-color: transparent; border-radius: 50%; content: ""; animation: sr-spin 700ms linear infinite; }
.sr-button--paper { background: var(--sr-seafoam); color: var(--sr-ink); border-color: var(--sr-seafoam); }
.sr-button--paper:hover { background: var(--sr-paper); border-color: var(--sr-paper); }
.sr-text-link {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 44px;
  color: inherit;
  font: 600 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-body);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.sr-text-link::after {
  position: absolute;
  right: 100%;
  bottom: 8px;
  left: 0;
  height: 1px;
  background: currentColor;
  content: "";
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: left;
  transition: transform var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out);
}
.sr-text-link:hover::after,
.sr-text-link:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
.sr-text-link--button { border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; }

.sr-intro__orb {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: min(100%, 610px);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  justify-self: end;
  border: 1px solid var(--sr-rule);
  background: var(--sr-paper-2);
  isolation: isolate;
}
.sr-intro__orb::before {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 11%;
  border: 1px solid var(--sr-rule);
  border-radius: 50%;
  content: "";
}
.sr-intro__orb::after {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 26%;
  border: 1px solid var(--sr-seafoam-deep);
  border-radius: 50%;
  content: "";
}
.sr-intro__orb-grid {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: linear-gradient(var(--sr-rule-soft) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--sr-rule-soft) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 25% 25%;
  opacity: 0.45;
}
.sr-intro__orb-reading { position: relative; z-index: 2; display: grid; gap: var(--space-xs); text-align: center; }
.sr-intro__orb-reading span { color: var(--sr-ink-2); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-body); }
.sr-intro__orb-reading strong { color: var(--sr-ink); font: 500 clamp(3.5rem, 7vw, 6.5rem)/0.85 var(--sr-display); letter-spacing: -0.06em; }
.sr-intro__orb-reading small { color: var(--sr-ink-2); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-mono); }
.sr-intro__orb > span { position: absolute; z-index: 3; width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--sr-paper-2); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sr-lavender-deep); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--sr-lavender-deep); }
.sr-intro__orb > span:nth-of-type(1) { top: 12%; left: 50%; }
.sr-intro__orb > span:nth-of-type(2) { right: 17%; bottom: 21%; background: var(--sr-seafoam-deep); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--sr-seafoam-deep); }
.sr-intro__orb > span:nth-of-type(3) { bottom: 31%; left: 17%; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: var(--sr-ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--sr-ink); }

/* Shared section frame */
.sr-landing-section {
  position: relative;
  padding: var(--section-gap) 0;
  border-top: var(--rule-hair) solid var(--sr-rule);
  overflow: clip;
  scroll-margin-top: 92px;
}
.sr-landing-section > .sr-panel__inner {
  display: grid;
  gap: var(--space-2xl);
  width: min(var(--container), 100%);
  min-height: 0;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 var(--sr-gutter);
}
.sr-landing-section--lavender { background: var(--sr-lavender); }
.sr-landing-section--seafoam { background: var(--sr-seafoam); }
.sr-landing-section--ink { background: var(--sr-ink); color: var(--sr-paper); border-top-color: var(--sr-ink); }
.sr-panel__header { display: grid; gap: var(--space-lg); max-width: 760px; }
.sr-folio { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-lg); color: var(--sr-ink-2); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.25 var(--sr-body); }
.sr-folio span:last-child { font-family: var(--sr-mono); }
.sr-panel__title { max-width: 12ch; font: 500 var(--text-section)/0.9 var(--sr-display); }
.sr-panel__intro { max-width: 50ch; color: var(--sr-ink-2); font-size: var(--text-lead); line-height: 1.45; }
.sr-landing-section--ink .sr-folio,
.sr-landing-section--ink .sr-panel__intro { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 76%, transparent); }

/* Scroll reveals stay hidden only after the early script marks the document as JS-enabled. */
html.js [data-reveal] { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0, var(--motion-distance), 0); clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); transition: opacity var(--dur-entrance) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-entrance) var(--ease-out), clip-path var(--dur-entrance) var(--ease-in-out); transition-delay: calc(var(--sr-delay, 0ms) + var(--sr-index, 0) * var(--motion-stagger)); }
html.js [data-reveal="rise"] { clip-path: inset(0); }
html.js [data-reveal="scale"] { transform: translate3d(0, var(--motion-distance), 0) scale(0.94); clip-path: inset(0); }
html.js [data-reveal="draw"] { opacity: 1; transform: scaleX(0.02); clip-path: inset(0); transform-origin: left; }
html.js [data-reveal][data-in="true"] { opacity: 1; transform: none; clip-path: inset(0); }
html.js [data-reveal="draw"][data-in="true"] { transform: scaleX(1); }

/* Bureau: a ruled reading spread */
.sr-bureau__grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0;
  margin-top: var(--space-xl);
  border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 50%, transparent);
  border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 50%, transparent);
}
.sr-bureau__note { min-height: 190px; padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-lg) var(--space-xl) 0; border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 50%, transparent); }
.sr-bureau__note:nth-child(2) { padding-left: var(--space-lg); }
.sr-bureau__note:last-child { padding-right: 0; padding-left: var(--space-lg); border-right: 0; }
.sr-note-index { display: block; margin-bottom: var(--space-2xl); color: var(--sr-ink-2); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1 var(--sr-mono); }
.sr-bureau__note p { max-width: 32ch; font-size: var(--text-md); line-height: 1.5; }
.sr-bureau__field { position: relative; min-height: 240px; margin-top: var(--space-xl); border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 42%, transparent); }
.sr-bureau__field .sr-isobar { position: absolute; inset: 20px 0 0; width: 100%; height: calc(100% - 20px); }
.sr-bureau__field > span { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; color: var(--sr-ink-2); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-body); }

/* Instruments: three open plates */
.sr-instruments { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--gap-columns); margin-top: var(--space-xl); }
.sr-instrument { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 200px 1fr; gap: var(--space-lg); min-width: 0; padding: var(--space-lg) 0 0; border-top: 2px solid var(--sr-ink); }
.sr-instrument svg { width: min(100%, 190px); height: 190px; margin: 0 auto; }
.sr-instrument > div { display: grid; align-content: start; gap: var(--space-xs); }
.sr-instrument__code { color: var(--sr-ink-2); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-body); }
.sr-instrument h3 { font: 500 clamp(1.9rem, 3vw, 3rem)/0.95 var(--sr-display); }
.sr-instrument p { max-width: 30ch; color: var(--sr-ink-2); font-size: var(--text-md); }
.sr-instruments + .sr-text-link { margin-top: var(--space-xl); }

/* Forecast: a working strip */
.sr-forecast-strip { margin-top: var(--space-xl); border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 58%, transparent); }
.sr-forecast-strip__tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 58%, transparent); }
.sr-forecast-strip__tab { position: relative; display: grid; gap: var(--space-xs); justify-items: start; min-height: 80px; padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-sm) var(--space-lg) 0; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 34%, transparent); background: transparent; color: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font: 600 var(--text-md)/1.1 var(--sr-body); transition: background-color var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out), transform var(--dur-micro) var(--ease-out); }
.sr-forecast-strip__tab:last-child { border-right: 0; }
.sr-forecast-strip__tab span { color: var(--sr-ink-2); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1 var(--sr-mono); }
.sr-forecast-strip__tab small { color: var(--sr-ink); font: 600 var(--text-md)/1.1 var(--sr-body); }
.sr-forecast-strip__tab::after { position: absolute; right: 100%; bottom: -1px; left: 0; height: 3px; background: var(--sr-ink); content: ""; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out); }
.sr-forecast-strip__tab:hover,
.sr-forecast-strip__tab:focus-visible { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 18%, transparent); }
.sr-forecast-strip__tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 24%, transparent); }
.sr-forecast-strip__tab[aria-selected="true"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
.sr-forecast-strip__tab:active { transform: translateY(1px); }
.sr-forecast-strip__window { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 5fr) minmax(0, 7fr); align-items: center; gap: var(--gap-columns); min-height: 390px; padding: var(--space-2xl) 0; }
.sr-forecast-strip__window { animation: sr-window-in var(--dur-long) var(--ease-out) both; }
.sr-forecast-strip__copy { max-width: 34ch; }
.sr-forecast-strip__code { display: block; margin-bottom: var(--space-lg); color: var(--sr-ink-2); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-body); }
.sr-forecast-strip__copy h3 { font: 500 clamp(3.25rem, 6vw, 6.4rem)/0.88 var(--sr-display); }
.sr-forecast-strip__copy p { margin-top: var(--space-lg); font-size: var(--text-lead); line-height: 1.45; }
.sr-forecast-strip__readings { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-sm) var(--space-lg); margin-top: var(--space-xl); color: var(--sr-ink-2); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-mono); }
.sr-forecast-strip__trace { width: 100%; height: auto; }
.sr-forecast-strip__line { stroke-dasharray: 980; stroke-dashoffset: 980; }
.sr-forecast-strip.is-visible .sr-forecast-strip__line { animation: sr-trace-draw 1200ms var(--ease-out) 120ms both; }

/* Field notes: paper cards on a ruled field */
.sr-field-notes { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--gap-columns); margin-top: var(--space-xl); }
.sr-field-note { position: relative; display: grid; align-content: start; min-height: 300px; padding: var(--space-lg) var(--space-lg) var(--space-xl); border: 1px solid var(--sr-rule); background: var(--sr-paper-2); }
.sr-field-note::before { position: absolute; top: -1px; right: var(--space-lg); left: var(--space-lg); height: 2px; background: var(--sr-lavender-deep); content: ""; }
.sr-field-note__dot { position: absolute; top: var(--space-lg); right: var(--space-lg); width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 2px solid var(--sr-paper-2); border-radius: 50%; background: var(--sr-lavender-deep); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--sr-lavender-deep); }
.sr-field-note__time { display: block; margin-bottom: var(--space-2xl); color: var(--sr-ink-2); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-body); }
.sr-field-note h3 { max-width: 13ch; font: 500 clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 3.6rem)/0.9 var(--sr-display); }
.sr-field-note p { max-width: 30ch; margin-top: var(--space-lg); color: var(--sr-ink-2); font-size: var(--text-md); }

/* Dispatch: index rows */
.sr-dispatch-list { display: grid; margin-top: var(--space-xl); border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 54%, transparent); }
.sr-dispatch-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0, 1fr) auto 24px; align-items: center; gap: var(--gap-columns); min-height: 76px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 54%, transparent); color: inherit; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out); }
.sr-dispatch-row:hover,
.sr-dispatch-row:focus-visible { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-seafoam) 48%, transparent); }
.sr-dispatch-row > span,
.sr-dispatch-row small { color: var(--sr-ink-2); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-body); }
.sr-dispatch-row strong { min-width: 0; font: 500 clamp(1.55rem, 2.8vw, 2.6rem)/1 var(--sr-display); overflow-wrap: break-word; }
.sr-dispatch-row i { color: var(--sr-ink); font-size: 1.5rem; font-style: normal; transition: transform var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out); }
.sr-dispatch-row:hover i,
.sr-dispatch-row:focus-visible i { transform: translate3d(4px, -2px, 0) rotate(-8deg); }
.sr-dispatch__footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-lg); margin-top: var(--space-lg); color: var(--sr-ink-2); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.3 var(--sr-body); }

/* Dispatch form and close */
.sr-subscribe { display: grid; gap: var(--space-xl); margin-top: var(--space-xl); padding-top: var(--space-xl); border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 38%, transparent); }
.sr-subscribe__fields { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: var(--gap-columns); }
.sr-field { display: grid; gap: var(--space-xs); min-width: 0; }
.sr-field > span { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 80%, transparent); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-body); }
.sr-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 var(--space-sm); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 56%, transparent); border-radius: var(--radius-input); outline: 2px solid transparent; outline-offset: -3px; background: transparent; color: var(--sr-paper); font: var(--text-md)/1.2 var(--sr-body); transition: background-color var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out), border-color var(--dur-short) var(--ease-out); }
.sr-field input:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 8%, transparent); }
.sr-field input:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--sr-seafoam); }
.sr-field input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--sr-lavender); }
.sr-field input:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; }
.sr-field small { min-height: 1lh; color: var(--sr-lavender); font: var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-body); }
.sr-subscribe__submit { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: var(--space-lg); }
.sr-subscribe__submit p { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 78%, transparent); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.45 var(--sr-body); }
.sr-subscribe__submit p span { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 58%, transparent); }
.sr-success { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: var(--gap-columns); margin-top: var(--space-xl); padding-top: var(--space-xl); border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 38%, transparent); animation: sr-success-in var(--dur-long) var(--ease-out) both; }
.sr-success__seal { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 80px; height: 80px; border: 2px solid var(--sr-seafoam); border-radius: 50%; color: var(--sr-seafoam); font: 600 var(--text-md)/1 var(--sr-mono); transform: rotate(-8deg); }
.sr-success__code { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 76%, transparent); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-body); }
.sr-success h3 { margin-top: var(--space-xs); color: var(--sr-paper); font: 500 clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 5.2rem)/0.9 var(--sr-display); }
.sr-success p { max-width: 40ch; margin-top: var(--space-sm); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 76%, transparent); font-size: var(--text-md); }
.sr-success .sr-text-link { grid-column: 2; justify-self: start; color: var(--sr-seafoam); }
.sr-back-cover { display: grid; gap: var(--space-xs); margin-top: var(--space-2xl); padding-top: var(--space-lg); border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 38%, transparent); }
.sr-back-cover span { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 74%, transparent); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-body); }
.sr-back-cover b { color: var(--sr-paper); font: 500 clamp(4rem, 10vw, 9rem)/0.78 var(--sr-display); letter-spacing: -0.06em; }
.sr-back-cover small { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 60%, transparent); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.2 var(--sr-body); }

/* Footer */
.sr-footer { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: end; gap: var(--gap-columns); width: min(var(--container), 100%); margin: 0 auto; padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--sr-gutter) var(--space-3xl); border-top: var(--rule-hair) solid var(--sr-rule); }
.sr-footer p { max-width: 28ch; color: var(--sr-ink-2); font: 500 var(--text-sm)/1.45 var(--sr-body); }
.sr-footer p span { color: var(--sr-ink-2); }
.sr-footer__links { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-lg); }
.sr-footer__top { justify-self: end; }

/* Content stays present without scripting; only the hero settles in. */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .sr-intro__copy { animation: sr-settle var(--dur-long) var(--ease-out) both; }
  .sr-intro__orb { animation: sr-settle var(--dur-long) var(--ease-out) 80ms both; }
}
@keyframes sr-settle { from { opacity: 0.01; transform: translateY(14px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }
@keyframes sr-success-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0, 18px, 0) scale(0.98); clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; clip-path: inset(0); } }
@keyframes sr-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
@keyframes sr-window-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translate3d(0, 18px, 0); clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; clip-path: inset(0); } }
@keyframes sr-trace-draw { from { stroke-dashoffset: 980; opacity: 0.25; } to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; opacity: 1; } }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html.js [data-reveal],
  html.js [data-reveal][data-in="true"],
  html.js [data-reveal="draw"],
  html.js [data-reveal="draw"][data-in="true"] { opacity: 1; transform: none; clip-path: inset(0); transition: none; }
  .sr-button[aria-busy="true"]::after { animation: none; }
  .sr-success, .sr-forecast-strip__window, .sr-pressure-trace__line { animation: none; }
}

@media (max-width: 60rem) {
  .sr-header { grid-template-columns: auto auto; gap: var(--space-sm) var(--space-lg); }
  .sr-nav { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 2; justify-content: flex-start; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: var(--space-2xs); scrollbar-width: none; }
  .sr-nav::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .sr-header__cta { justify-self: end; }
  .sr-intro { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-2xl); min-height: 0; padding-top: var(--space-3xl); }
  .sr-intro h1 { max-width: 10ch; font-size: clamp(4.4rem, 15vw, 8rem); }
  .sr-intro__orb { width: min(82vw, 540px); justify-self: start; }
  .sr-landing-section { padding-top: var(--section-gap-s); padding-bottom: var(--section-gap-s); }
  .sr-instruments, .sr-field-notes { gap: var(--space-md); }
  .sr-instrument { grid-template-rows: 180px 1fr; }
  .sr-forecast-strip__window { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-xl); min-height: 0; }
  .sr-forecast-strip__copy { max-width: 38ch; }
  .sr-forecast-strip__trace { max-width: 720px; }
  .sr-footer { grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); gap: var(--space-xl); }
  .sr-footer__links { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .sr-footer__top { justify-self: end; }
}

@media (max-width: 40rem) {
  .sr-header { min-height: 72px; padding-top: var(--space-xs); padding-bottom: var(--space-xs); }
  .sr-logo__mark { width: 36px; height: 36px; }
  .sr-logo__words small { display: none; }
  .sr-header__cta { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 var(--space-sm); font-size: var(--text-xs); }
  .sr-intro { padding-top: var(--space-2xl); padding-bottom: var(--space-2xl); }
  .sr-intro__meta { gap: var(--space-xs) var(--space-sm); font-size: var(--text-xs); }
  .sr-intro h1 { font-size: clamp(3.7rem, 17vw, 5.8rem); }
  .sr-intro > p { margin-top: var(--space-lg); font-size: var(--text-md); }
  .sr-intro__actions { align-items: stretch; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-sm); margin-top: var(--space-lg); }
  .sr-intro__actions .sr-button { width: 100%; }
  .sr-intro__orb { width: 100%; }
  .sr-panel__title { font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 14vw, 4.5rem); }
  .sr-panel__intro { font-size: var(--text-md); }
  .sr-folio { gap: var(--space-sm); font-size: var(--text-xs); }
  .sr-bureau__grid, .sr-instruments, .sr-field-notes { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .sr-bureau__note, .sr-bureau__note:nth-child(2), .sr-bureau__note:last-child { min-height: 0; padding: var(--space-lg) 0; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 50%, transparent); }
  .sr-bureau__note:last-child { border-bottom: 0; }
  .sr-note-index { margin-bottom: var(--space-lg); }
  .sr-bureau__field { min-height: 190px; }
  .sr-instrument { grid-template-columns: 112px minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: auto; align-items: center; padding-top: var(--space-md); }
  .sr-instrument svg { width: 104px; height: 104px; }
  .sr-instrument h3 { font-size: 2.1rem; }
  .sr-forecast-strip__tabs { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .sr-forecast-strip__tab { min-height: 72px; padding-right: var(--space-xs); }
  .sr-forecast-strip__tab small { font-size: var(--text-sm); }
  .sr-forecast-strip__copy h3 { font-size: clamp(3.25rem, 16vw, 5.5rem); }
  .sr-field-note { min-height: 240px; }
  .sr-dispatch-row { grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr) 20px; gap: var(--space-sm); min-height: 70px; }
  .sr-dispatch-row small { display: none; }
  .sr-dispatch-row strong { font-size: 1.6rem; }
  .sr-dispatch__footer { display: grid; gap: var(--space-xs); font-size: var(--text-xs); }
  .sr-subscribe__fields { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .sr-subscribe__submit { align-items: stretch; flex-direction: column; }
  .sr-subscribe__submit .sr-button { width: 100%; }
  .sr-success { grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); padding-top: var(--space-lg); }
  .sr-success__seal { width: 62px; height: 62px; font-size: var(--text-sm); }
  .sr-success h3 { font-size: 2.7rem; }
  .sr-success .sr-text-link { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
  .sr-footer { grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); padding-top: var(--space-xl); padding-bottom: var(--space-2xl); }
}

    <file path="src/app/(serein)/serein/tokens.css">
<![CDATA[:root {
  --space-3xs: 2px;
  --space-2xs: 4px;
  --space-xs: 8px;
  --space-sm: 12px;
  --space-md: 16px;
  --space-lg: 24px;
  --space-xl: 40px;
  --space-2xl: 64px;
  --space-3xl: 96px;
  --space-4xl: 144px;

  --text-xs: 0.8125rem;
  --text-sm: 0.875rem;
  --text-md: 1rem;
  --text-lg: 1.25rem;
  --text-xl: 1.5625rem;
  --text-2xl: 1.953rem;
  --text-3xl: 2.441rem;
  --text-display-s: clamp(2.5rem, 4vw + 0.5rem, 4.5rem);
  --text-display: clamp(4.5rem, 8vw + 0.25rem, 8.5rem);
  --text-section: clamp(2.75rem, 4vw + 0.5rem, 5rem);
  --text-title: clamp(1.4rem, 0.75vw + 1rem, 1.85rem);
  --text-lead: clamp(1.125rem, 0.35vw + 1rem, 1.375rem);

  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --ease-in-out: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1);
  --ease-gesture: cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1);
  --dur-micro: 120ms;
  --dur-short: 220ms;
  --dur-long: 560ms;
  --dur-entrance: 760ms;
  --motion-stagger: 70ms;
  --motion-distance: 24px;

  --sr-ink: #24343A;
  --sr-ink-2: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 70%, var(--sr-paper));
  --sr-paper: #F6F0E5;
  --sr-paper-2: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 86%, var(--sr-ink));
  --sr-paper-3: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-paper) 78%, var(--sr-ink));
  --sr-rule: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 42%, var(--sr-paper));
  --sr-rule-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 22%, var(--sr-paper));
  --sr-seafoam: #A8D6CC;
  --sr-seafoam-deep: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-seafoam) 65%, var(--sr-ink));
  --sr-lavender: #C7BCE6;
  --sr-lavender-deep: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-lavender) 60%, var(--sr-ink));
  --sr-error: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-lavender) 70%, var(--sr-ink));

  --color-paper: var(--sr-paper);
  --color-paper-2: var(--sr-paper-2);
  --color-paper-3: var(--sr-paper-3);
  --color-ink: var(--sr-ink);
  --color-ink-2: var(--sr-ink-2);
  --color-muted: var(--sr-ink-2);
  --color-rule: var(--sr-rule);
  --color-accent: var(--sr-seafoam);
  --color-accent-ink: var(--sr-ink);
  --color-focus: var(--sr-lavender-deep);
  --color-error: var(--sr-error);
  --color-success: var(--sr-seafoam-deep);

  --font-display: var(--font-lora), Georgia, serif;
  --font-body: var(--font-public-sans), system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-outlier: var(--font-ibm-plex-mono), ui-monospace, monospace;
  --sr-display: var(--font-display);
  --sr-body: var(--font-body);
  --sr-mono: var(--font-outlier);

  --container: 1440px;
  --gutter: clamp(20px, 5vw, 72px);
  --gap-columns: 32px;
  --section-gap-s: clamp(88px, 10vw, 128px);
  --section-gap: clamp(112px, 13vw, 176px);
  --section-gap-l: clamp(144px, 16vw, 224px);
  --radius-card: 2px;
  --radius-input: 2px;
  --radius-pill: 999px;
  --rule-hair: 1px;
  --shadow-card: 0 16px 36px color-mix(in srgb, var(--sr-ink) 8%, transparent);
  --tracking-display: -0.045em;
  --z-base: 1;
  --z-raised: 10;
  --z-sticky: 200;
  --z-toast: 500;
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(serein)/serein/brand/Logo.tsx">
<![CDATA[type LogoProps = { compact?: boolean; className?: string };

export function Mark({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg
      className={className}
      viewBox="0 0 64 64"
      role="img"
      aria-label="SEREIN Bureau mark"
      focusable="false"
    >
      <title>SEREIN Bureau mark</title>
      <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="22" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" />
      <path d="M8 36c12-7 25-7 48 0" fill="none" stroke="var(--sr-seafoam)" strokeWidth="3" />

<![CDATA["use client";

import { FormEvent, useState } from "react";
import { validateSubscribe, type SubscribeErrors } from "./validate-subscribe";

export function Subscribe() {
  const [values, setValues] = useState({ name: "", email: "" });
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<SubscribeErrors>({});
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<"idle" | "loading" | "success">("idle");

  const update = (field: "name" | "email", value: string) => {
    setValues((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));
    if (errors[field]) setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: undefined }));
  };

  const submit = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const nextErrors = validateSubscribe(values);
    setErrors(nextErrors);
    if (Object.keys(nextErrors).length) {
      const first = Object.keys(nextErrors)[0] as "name" | "email";
      document.getElementById(`serein-${first}`)?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setStatus("loading");
    window.setTimeout(() => setStatus("success"), 420);
  };

  if (status === "success") {
    return (
      <div className="sr-success" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        <span className="sr-success__seal" aria-hidden="true">SR</span>
        <div><span className="sr-success__code">Dispatched / SR-07</span><h3>Weather, on its way.</h3><p>Thanks, {values.name.trim() || "observer"}. The next report will arrive with the next new moon.</p></div>
        <button className="sr-text-link sr-text-link--button" type="button" onClick={() => { setStatus("idle"); setValues({ name: "", email: "" }); }}>File another name</button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <form className="sr-subscribe" onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
      <div className="sr-subscribe__fields">
        <label className="sr-field"><span>Name</span><input id="serein-name" name="name" value={values.name} onChange={(event) => update("name", event.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.name)} aria-describedby={errors.name ? "serein-name-error" : undefined} autoComplete="name" aria-required="true" />{errors.name && <small id="serein-name-error">{errors.name}</small>}</label>
        <label className="sr-field"><span>Email</span><input id="serein-email" type="email" name="email" value={values.email} onChange={(event) => update("email", event.target.value)} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.email)} aria-describedby={errors.email ? "serein-email-error" : undefined} autoComplete="email" aria-required="true" />{errors.email && <small id="serein-email-error">{errors.email}</small>}</label>
      </div>
      <div className="sr-subscribe__submit"><p>One report / new moon<br /><span>No tracking. No noise.</span></p><button className="sr-button sr-button--paper" type="submit" disabled={status === "loading"} aria-busy={status === "loading"}>{status === "loading" ? "Filing..." : "Join the dispatch"}</button></div>
    </form>
  );
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(serein)/serein/forms/validate-subscribe.ts">
<![CDATA[export type SubscribeValues = { name: string; email: string };
export type SubscribeErrors = Partial<Record<keyof SubscribeValues, string>>;

export function validateSubscribe(values: SubscribeValues): SubscribeErrors {
  const errors: SubscribeErrors = {};
  if (!values.name.trim()) errors.name = "Add your name";
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(values.email.trim())) errors.email = "Enter a valid email";
  return errors;
}
]]>

    <file path="src/app/(serein)/serein/motion/math.ts">
<![CDATA[export function clamp01(value: number): number {
  return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, value));
}

export function lerp(from: number, to: number, amount: number): number {
  return from + (to - from) * amount;
}

export function progressFromOffsets(offset: number, start: number, end: number): number {
  if (end <= start) return 0;
  return clamp01((offset - start) / (end - start));
}

export function staggerDelay(index: number, step = 70, cap = 600): number {
  return Math.min(cap, Math.max(0, index) * step);
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import type { CSSProperties, ElementType, ReactNode } from "react";
import { useInView } from "./useInView";

type RevealProps = {
  as?: ElementType;
  variant?: "rise" | "mask" | "wipe" | "scale" | "draw" | "slide-left" | "slide-right";
  delay?: number;
  index?: number;
  className?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
};

export function Reveal({ as: Tag = "div", variant = "rise", delay = 0, index = 0, className, children }: RevealProps) {
  const { ref, inView } = useInView<HTMLElement>();
  const style = { "--sr-delay": `${delay}ms`, "--sr-index": index } as CSSProperties;
  return (
    <Tag ref={ref} className={className} data-reveal={variant} data-in={inView ? "true" : "false"} style={style}>
      {children}
    </Tag>
  );
}

    <file path="src/app/(serein)/serein/motion/ScrollEffects.tsx">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect } from "react";

function syncScrollState() {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  const body = document.body;
  const range = Math.max(1, root.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight);
  const progress = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, window.scrollY / range));
  root.style.setProperty("--sr-scroll-progress", progress.toFixed(3));
  body.dataset.scrolled = window.scrollY > 24 ? "true" : "false";
}

export function ScrollEffects() {
  useEffect(() => {
    let frame = 0;
    const onScroll = () => {
      if (frame) return;
      frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        frame = 0;
        syncScrollState();
      });
    };

    syncScrollState();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", onScroll, { passive: true });

    const links = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll<HTMLAnchorElement>(".sr-nav a[href^='#']"));
    const sections = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>("main section[id]"));
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
          const id = entry.target.id;
          links.forEach((link) => {
            const active = link.getAttribute("href") === `#${id}`;
            if (active) link.setAttribute("aria-current", "true");
            else link.removeAttribute("aria-current");
          });
        });
      },
      { rootMargin: "-24% 0px -62% 0px", threshold: [0, 0.2, 0.6] },
    );

    sections.forEach((section) => observer.observe(section));
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", onScroll);
      if (frame) window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
      observer.disconnect();
    };
  }, []);

  return null;
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(serein)/serein/motion/useInView.ts">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

export function useInView<T extends HTMLElement>(rootMargin = "0px 0px -12% 0px") {
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);
  const [inView, setInView] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const node = ref.current;
    if (!node || typeof IntersectionObserver === "undefined") {
      setInView(true);
      return;
    }
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry?.isIntersecting) {
          setInView(true);
          observer.unobserve(node);
        }
      },
      { rootMargin },
    );
    observer.observe(node);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [rootMargin]);

  return { ref, inView };
}
]]>
    </file>
    <file path="src/app/(serein)/serein/motion/useReducedMotion.ts">
<![CDATA["use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export function useReducedMotion(): boolean {
  const [reduced, setReduced] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const query = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    const update = () => setReduced(query.matches);
    update();
    query.addEventListener("change", update);
    return () => query.removeEventListener("change", update);
  }, []);

  return reduced;
}
]]>

<![CDATA["use client";

import { useState } from "react";

const WINDOWS = [

];

function MiniTrace({ active }: { active: number }) {
  const lines = [
    "M20 168C64 151 92 120 142 132s54-34 96-25 52 37 96 17 58-59 103-41 47-20 83-50",

        <path d="M20 20v180M165 20v180M310 20v180M455 20v180M600 20v180" />

    </svg>
  );
}

export function ForecastStrip() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);
  const { ref, inView } = useInView<HTMLDivElement>("0px 0px -18% 0px");
  const window = WINDOWS[active];
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={`sr-forecast-strip${inView ? " is-visible" : ""}`} data-active-window={active}>
      <div className="sr-forecast-strip__tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Forecast windows">
        {WINDOWS.map((item, index) => (
          <button key={item.code} className="sr-forecast-strip__tab" type="button" role="tab" aria-selected={active === index} aria-controls={`forecast-window-${index}`} aria-label={`${item.code} ${item.label.toUpperCase()}`} onClick={() => setActive(index)}>
            <span>{item.code}</span><small>{item.label}</small>
          </button>

      </div>
      <div key={window.code} className="sr-forecast-strip__window" id={`forecast-window-${active}`} role="tabpanel" aria-live="polite">

          <p>{window.copy}</p>
          <div className="sr-forecast-strip__readings"><span>{window.reading}</span><span>{window.wind}</span></div>
        </div>
        <MiniTrace key={window.code} active={active} />

    </div>
  );
}

<![CDATA[import { Reveal } from "../motion/Reveal";
import { Subscribe } from "../forms/Subscribe";

export type PanelKey = "outlook" | "bureau" | "instruments" | "forecast" | "notes" | "dispatch" | "subscribe";

export type PanelSpec = {
  id: PanelKey;
  label: string;
  eyebrow: string;
  code: string;
  tone: "paper" | "seafoam" | "lavender" | "ink";
};

export const PANELS: PanelSpec[] = [
  { id: "outlook", label: "Today's outlook", eyebrow: "Desk 01 of 07", code: "SR-07 / 08:10", tone: "paper" },
  { id: "bureau", label: "The bureau note", eyebrow: "Desk 02 of 07", code: "SR-07 / note", tone: "lavender" },
  { id: "instruments", label: "Instruments", eyebrow: "Desk 03 of 07", code: "SR-07 / tools", tone: "paper" },
  { id: "forecast", label: "The forecast strip", eyebrow: "Desk 04 of 07", code: "SR-07 / trace", tone: "seafoam" },
  { id: "notes", label: "Field notes", eyebrow: "Desk 05 of 07", code: "SR-07 / field", tone: "paper" },
  { id: "dispatch", label: "Dispatch index", eyebrow: "Desk 06 of 07", code: "SR-07 / index", tone: "lavender" },
  { id: "subscribe", label: "Subscribe", eyebrow: "Desk 07 of 07", code: "SR-07 / send", tone: "ink" },
];

function Folio({ panel }: { panel: PanelSpec }) {
  return (
    <div className="sr-folio">
      <span>{panel.eyebrow}</span>
      <span>{panel.code}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

function CloudGlyph({ variant = "cloud" }: { variant?: "cloud" | "rain" | "sun" }) {
  return (
    <svg className={`sr-cloud sr-cloud--${variant}`} viewBox="0 0 320 190" role="img" aria-label={`${variant} weather glyph`}>
      {variant === "sun" ? (
        <>
          <circle cx="160" cy="92" r="48" fill="var(--sr-lavender)" />
          <g fill="none" stroke="var(--sr-ink)" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round">
            <path d="M160 22v20M160 142v20M90 92H70M250 92h-20M111 43 96 28M209 43l15-15M111 141l-15 15M209 141l15 15" />
          </g>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <path d="M57 132c-13-24 4-53 33-53 10-30 54-43 80-14 38-11 69 14 69 46 31 0 48 18 48 38H62c-12 0-20-7-5-17Z" fill="var(--sr-paper)" stroke="var(--sr-ink)" strokeWidth="3" />
          {variant === "rain" && (

              <path d="M105 155v20M154 155v20M203 155v20" />

}

function IsobarField() {

        <path d="M0 100c120-52 215 52 345 0s220 56 335 0" />
        <path d="M0 158c120-52 215 52 345 0s220 56 335 0" />
        <path d="M0 216c120-52 215 52 345 0s220 56 335 0" />
        <path d="M0 274c120-52 215 52 345 0s220 56 335 0" />

      <circle cx="440" cy="101" r="11" fill="var(--sr-lavender)" />

function Barometer() {

function PanelHeader({ panel, title, intro }: { panel: PanelSpec; title: string; intro?: string }) {

    </div>
  );
}

export function PanelContent({ panel }: { panel: PanelSpec }) {
  switch (panel.id) {
    case "outlook":
      return (
        <>
          <PanelHeader panel={panel} title="A little weather, held close." intro="A morning report for the places between the forecast and the feeling. Filed from the SEREIN desk, 51.52° N / 0.09° W." />
          <div className="sr-outlook__art" aria-label="A coded weather scene">
            <IsobarField />
            <div className="sr-outlook__clouds"><CloudGlyph variant="cloud" /><CloudGlyph variant="sun" /></div>
            <div className="sr-outlook__stamp"><span>SR</span><b>07</b><small>Field / 08:10</small></div>

          <div className="sr-panel__actions">
            <a className="sr-button" href="#forecast">Open the forecast</a>
            <a className="sr-text-link" href="#bureau">Read the bureau note</a>
          </div>
        </>
      );
    case "bureau":
      return (
        <>
          <PanelHeader panel={panel} title="Forecasts are a way of paying attention." intro="We keep the numbers close to the ordinary: the damp rail, the bright corner of a kitchen, the hour when the wind turns." />
          <div className="sr-bureau__grid">
            <Reveal as="div" variant="rise" index={0} className="sr-bureau__note"><span className="sr-note-index">01</span><p>Weather is a shared language. A pressure trace can still tell you where to look.</p></Reveal>
            <Reveal as="div" variant="rise" index={1} className="sr-bureau__note"><span className="sr-note-index">02</span><p>SEREIN keeps a record of small shifts and sends one issue every new moon.</p></Reveal>
            <Reveal as="div" variant="rise" index={2} className="sr-bureau__note"><span className="sr-note-index">03</span><p>Read the strip left to right. Let the day arrive at its own pace.</p></Reveal>
          </div>
          <div className="sr-bureau__field"><IsobarField /><span>Isobar field / observation 07</span></div>
        </>
      );
    case "instruments":
      return (
        <>
          <PanelHeader panel={panel} title="Three instruments. One attentive morning." intro="The desk uses simple tools, held steady long enough for a pattern to appear." />
          <div className="sr-instruments">
            <Reveal as="article" variant="scale" index={0} className="sr-instrument"><Barometer /><div><span className="sr-instrument__code">01 / Barometer</span><h3>Pressure</h3><p>Steady at 1016 hPa. A good day to take the long way.</p></div></Reveal>
            <Reveal as="article" variant="scale" index={1} className="sr-instrument"><WindRose /><div><span className="sr-instrument__code">02 / Wind rose</span><h3>Direction</h3><p>South-west, 12 knots. The windows will hear it first.</p></div></Reveal>
            <Reveal as="article" variant="scale" index={2} className="sr-instrument sr-instrument--cloud"><CloudGlyph variant="rain" /><div><span className="sr-instrument__code">03 / Cloud deck</span><h3>Ceiling</h3><p>High, then lower by dusk. Carry a layer for the return.</p></div></Reveal>
          </div>
          <a className="sr-text-link" href="#forecast">Calibrate the strip</a>
        </>
      );
    case "forecast":
      return (
        <>
          <PanelHeader panel={panel} title="Read the pressure line." intro="The day's front is a quiet rise. Open the folds and follow it from first light to the last train home." />
          <div className="sr-forecast__trace"><PressureTrace /></div>
          <div className="sr-forecast__readings"><div><span>Now</span><strong>1016</strong><small>hPa</small></div><div><span>Wind</span><strong>12</strong><small>kt / SW</small></div><div><span>Visibility</span><strong>8.4</strong><small>km</small></div></div>
          <div className="sr-forecast__rule"><span>First light</span><i /><span>Last train home</span></div>
        </>
      );
    case "notes":
      return (
        <>
          <PanelHeader panel={panel} title="Field notes from a day in motion." intro="Three small observations, filed without hurry. Each one is a place the forecast touched." />
          <div className="sr-field-notes">
            <Reveal as="article" variant="rise" index={0} className="sr-field-note"><span className="sr-field-note__dot" /><span className="sr-field-note__time">06:42 / East platform</span><h3>The rail is dark with rain.</h3><p>It holds the first blue of the morning for a few seconds, then gives it back.</p></Reveal>
            <Reveal as="article" variant="rise" index={1} className="sr-field-note"><span className="sr-field-note__dot" /><span className="sr-field-note__time">12:16 / Market roof</span><h3>Wind finds the paper bags.</h3><p>South-west, as promised. The forecast is a note you can hear.</p></Reveal>
            <Reveal as="article" variant="rise" index={2} className="sr-field-note"><span className="sr-field-note__dot" /><span className="sr-field-note__time">19:08 / Back garden</span><h3>The cloud line opens.</h3><p>One clear window before dusk. Enough for the long way home.</p></Reveal>
          </div>
        </>
      );
    case "dispatch":
      return (
        <>
          <PanelHeader panel={panel} title="The dispatch index." intro="Previous reports from the SEREIN desk. Keep the ones that change the way a place feels." />
          <div className="sr-dispatch-list">
            {["A room that keeps the rain", "The wind behind the station", "Notes on a blue hour", "A forecast for the long way"].map((item, itemIndex) => (
              <a className="sr-dispatch-row" href="#subscribe" key={item}>
                <span>{String(itemIndex + 3).padStart(2, "0")}</span><strong>{item}</strong><small>Issue {String(itemIndex + 4).padStart(2, "0")} / 2026</small><i aria-hidden="true">↗</i>
              </a>
            ))}
          </div>
          <div className="sr-dispatch__footer"><span>7 reports / 4 cities / one open window</span><span>Keep the weather close</span></div>
        </>
      );
    case "subscribe":
      return (
        <>
          <PanelHeader panel={panel} title="Let the next report find you." intro="One small dispatch every new moon. No noise, no forecasts for sale, just a closer look at the weather already around you." />
          <Subscribe />
          <div className="sr-back-cover"><span>SR-07</span><b>SEREIN</b><small>Small weather / closely observed</small></div>
        </>
      );
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

]]>
    </file>
